name: Message Scheduler
shortDescription: Compose a message to be sent at a later date
description: Schedule messages with the /delay slash command, delivered later and sent as you, to the current channel, to other #channels, or as a direct message to @mentioned users. Repeat them with every day, every weekday or every monday at a chosen time, or set personal reminders with /remind. Times resolve in each user's own timezone, and an interactive list cancels or expands any message with one click.
